title: Columbo

A cunning advertising consultant leading a double life as a spy tries to cover up the details of a homicide.

title: Columbo
description:

A retired bullfighter credited with saving a young man from a bull arranges the death of the boy's father to protect his own reputation.

title: Columbo
description:

A magician claims an airtight alibi -- being sealed in a tank of water -- in the murder of a blackmailing associate.

title: Columbo
description:
S5 E6 — Last Salute to the Commodore
Lt. Columbo's prime suspect in the case of a drowned yacht magnate also turns up dead.

title: Columbo
description:

An egotistic TV detective matches wits with Columbo after murdering his producer, a former lover and current blackmailer.

title: Columbo
description:

The curator (Joyce Van Patten) of a strapped family-owned museum stages a robbery, for insurance, then murders to hide her crime; guests Celeste Holm, Tim O'Connor.

title: Columbo
description:
S6 E3 — The Bye-Bye Sky-High IQ Murder Case
An accountant, embezzling to support his wife's lifestyle, murders his partner after the man discovers his crimes.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E1 — Try & Catch Me
A mystery writer uses her plot as a guide to murder her nephew, whom she blames for her niece's death.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E2 — Murder Under Glass
Columbo investigates the murder of a gourmet restaurant owner who had been the victim of an extortionist.

title: Columbo
description:
S7 E5 — The Conspirators
An Irish poet, who fronts a peace organization while secretly running guns, kills an arms dealer who tries to swindle him.

title: Columbo
description:
S8 E3 — Sex and the Married Detective
The disheveled detective gets some free advice from a world-famous sex therapist.
